title: Committed sprites.json `order` is not pinned to sprites.odin files[] — test_sprite_order.py pins only the generator constant
evidence:
app/render/sprites.odin (sprites_parse_boxes — structural checks only, no order[i] == files[i] compare):
	order, oko := obj["order"].(json.Array)
	boxes, okb := obj["content_bbox"].(json.Object)
	if !oko || !okb || len(order) != SPRITE_COUNT {
		return false
	}

tools/test_sprite_order.py (reads only these two files — never assets/sprites/sprites.json):
GEN = ROOT / "tools" / "gen_sprites.py"
ODIN = ROOT / "app" / "render" / "sprites.odin"
detail: The renderer consumes the committed sprites.json via #load; a hand-edit reordering its order[] (README forbids but nothing enforces) passes sprites_parse_boxes and mis-crops silently until the next T2 golden run catches the pixel drift.
recommended_fix: Extend tools/test_sprite_order.py to also load assets/sprites/sprites.json and assert its `order` array equals the sprites.odin files[] list (currently consistent — house_0..3, host, dc, puck_1..3, small_biz, campus).
